table.caption: The same seven games each, counted two ways: one player with three wins and four losses, one with seven draws.

text: Two players have seven games each: Ana won three and lost four, Ben drew all seven. Each result is a real chess game, played to the end and paid under each of the two points rules a chess league offers.
Under the first rule a win is 1, a draw is ½ and a loss is 0; under the second a win is 3, a draw is 1 and a loss is 0.
Ana has 3 and Ben has 3½ under the first rule, 9 and 7 under the second.
